harness.experimentCreated: Experiment and first immutable revision created.

harness.protocolValid: Protocol, digests and asset references are consistent; execution is not authorized.

harness.snapshotValid: Snapshot manifest, Run documents and NPZ bytes are consistent.

diag.blocked: Blocked by the terrain ({terrain}): the motor reaches its torque limit ({limit} N·m) {n} time(s), {share} of the run in total.
diag.deep_sinkage: The feet sink {depth} mm into the ground (soft contact or heavy load).
diag.loop_open: A loop opened by {opening} mm at t = {time} s: the model has come apart and the numbers after that are not trustworthy.
diag.ok: No problem found: the walker advances normally, with a stride of {efficiency} of the ideal.
diag.ok.plain: No problem found: the walker advances normally.
diag.sail_torque_insufficient: The sail did not turn the crank: in a {wind} m/s wind and {rho} kg/m³ air it gives only about {torque} mN·m at standstill, not enough to overcome the walker's starting load.
diag.sail_weak: The sail barely turns the crank: {omega} rad/s on average, only {ratio} of the {free} rad/s it reaches unloaded. The load takes nearly all of the sail torque.
diag.slipping: The feet slip for {foot_s} foot-seconds ({share} of all foot time) and the stride is {efficiency} of the ideal.
diag.slow_unexplained: The walker covers only {efficiency} of its ideal stride, but no blocking, slipping or torque limit was found.
diag.title: Why did it go like this?
diag.torque_limit_too_low: The motor reaches its torque limit ({limit} N·m) {n} time(s), {share} of the run in total, and the walker makes little progress.
